products.verdict: The Z-Wave dimmer to buy. It works with the switches already in a 3-way or 4-way circuit and fits shallow boxes.
pros: Works with existing on/off switches in 3-, 4-, and 5-way circuits
800 Series with Long Range
Only 1.16 in. deep
Double tap to full brightness; programmable levels on hubs with advanced settings
Multicolor LED indicator with a night light mode
cons: The other switches in the circuit must be on/off switches, not dimmers
Voice control only through a Z-Wave hub

products.verdict: The toggle version of Zooz's dimmer, with direct 3-way and Long Range.

Direct 3-way and 4-way with no add-on switch
800 Series Long Range
5-year warranty once registered
cons: Not compatible with Luminus, Lithonia, or Feit bulbs, per the listing
Wires differently from the older ZEN23 and ZEN24

avoid.flag: Filler listing with no load rating, wiring, or model details
avoid.verdict: The listing tells you almost nothing about what you're buying. Three of its four bullets are filler, and none give a load rating or wiring requirements.
reasons: The bullets read "A Must Buy Item", "Built To Last", and "Great Item To Give as A Gift".
There's no LED or incandescent load rating, no neutral requirement, and no 3-way wiring information.
The spec table lists its size as 1 x 1 x 1 inch, which isn't the size of a wall dimmer.
For a few dollars more, the UltraPro and Eaton dimmers above publish their specs.
